deleteBody: "{{name}}" and everything inside it leave the workspace. Tabs looking at it stay open, pointing at nothing.
deleteExampleBody: "{{name}}" leaves the examples of its request. Tabs looking at it stay open, pointing at nothing.
deleteManyBody: {{count}} entries and everything inside them leave the workspace. Tabs looking at them stay open, pointing at nothing.
deleteManyExamplesBody: {{count}} examples leave their requests. Tabs looking at them stay open, pointing at nothing.
heading: Collections

console.log: Writes a line to the Console.
console.info: Writes an informational line to the Console.
console.warn: Writes a warning to the Console.
console.error: Writes an error to the Console.

api.URLSearchParams: Reads or builds a query string.

variables.get: The value of a variable. A secret gives undefined.
variables.set: Sets a script variable for the sends that follow.
variables.replaceIn: Resolves the variables of a text. A secret stays as text.

api.test: Declares a test: it passes if its function does not throw.
api.expect: Asserts something about a value inside a test.

request.url: The URL of the request. Writable before it is sent.
request.method: The method of the request. Writable before it is sent.
request.body: The body of the request as text. Writable before it is sent.

headers.get: The value of a request header.
headers.has: Whether the request carries the header.
headers.set: Sets or changes a request header.

query.get: The value of a query parameter.
query.has: Whether the query carries the parameter.
query.set: Sets or changes a query parameter.

response.status: The status code of the response.
response.time: How many milliseconds the response took.
response.text: The body of the response as text.
response.json: The body of the response read as JSON.

headers.get: The value of a response header.
headers.has: Whether the response carries the header.

message.direction: Whether the message arrived or left.
message.event: The Socket.IO event name of the message.
message.json: The text of the message read as JSON.

socket.send: Sends a message through the connection.

api.sendRequest: Sends another request and waits for its response. Its variables are not resolved and it follows no redirects.

log.values: Values to write, separated by a space.

info.values: Values to write, separated by a space.

warn.values: Values to write, separated by a space.

error.values: Values to write, separated by a space.

URLSearchParams.init: Query string, object or list of pairs to start from.

replaceIn.text: Text with variables in double braces.

test.name: Name of the test in the results.
test.body: Function of the test; it can be async.

sendRequest.options: URL, method, headers and body of the request.

assertion.chain: Only reads well: it does not change the assertion.
assertion.eql: Deeply equal: objects and lists by their content.
assertion.include: Contains the text, the list item or the pairs of the object.
assertion.match: The text matches the regular expression.
assertion.a: Is of that type: string, number, object, array, null…
assertion.an: Is of that type: string, number, object, array, null…
assertion.property: Has the property and, if given, with that value.

include.item: Text, item or pairs it must contain.

snippet.variableFromMessage: Save a field of the message
snippet.variableFromResponse: Save a field of the response

scriptTooLarge: Over the limit: it does not run
scriptUnapproved: It does not run until you approve it
unknownItem: Nothing in this window knows how to open an item of kind "{{kind}}".
skippedList: Scripts left out of the send
skippedApproved: Approved: it runs from the next send
skippedNotShown: {{bytes}} bytes, too many to show here. Open it in its editor to review it.
